doc.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996

title: Louis Armstrong teases Shearing over banana fritters in Toronto
summary: Shearing recalls Armstrong's joke about him eating fast at a Toronto restaurant near the Casino Theater.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you get a chance to meet and listen to Louis Armstrong in person?
Because he was part of our beginnings, too.

I’ll never forget one wonderful thing with Louis Armstrong. I had the quintet in the — I want to say Casino Theater in Toronto. And around the corner from there was a restaurant and I took the guys to dinner. And everything had sauce upon sauce upon sauce. So I ate the banana fritters, which was the only plain thing I could find. And in comes Louis you know. “Oh,” he said, “dig old Shearing getting in on the freebies there.” He said, “That cat’s eating so fast he looks like he’s smiling.”
Oh, Louis was a great tease.
